'''Stock Lights''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. It was owned by [[Cryle Cavv]], who met his nephew, [[Sienn Sconn]], in the bar to discuss a mission to "steal" the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Guardian (Executor-class)|''Guardian'']].<ref name="TFO" />
